scope: Independent read-only exact-source review of two frozen report-local diagnostic RTL files. No simulation rerun, vendor fit, real target/board loaded timing, endpoint completion or authority qualification.

findings.evidence: Transmitted command payload stays zero with initial SYNC only; commercial_active/factory_identity_verified/analog_valid remain hard false. Reset invalidates samples. Diagnostic accepted progress cannot authorize outputs or claim factory identity.

Returned byte3 compares exact expected hardware-major0 plus slot. This explicitly supports the archived read-only diagnostic target profile; upper nibble is hardware major, not universally reserved. Other majors cannot obtain accepted diagnostic progress.

CRC32C is computed from first36 response bytes; exact class/epoch/previous-command sequence and reset/fault/power/state/zero-output observations gate accepted. Completed synced polls advance bookkeeping even on rejected response, without advancing accepted progress. Sequence rollover skips zero.

After HOLD and CHECK, accepted/frame_seen/header_crc_good pulse with stable rx_shift. The provider samples that tuple on the next edge before START clears the next response; rejected frames do not overwrite last_valid_realtime.

One50MHz microsecond divider increments per-lane saturating16-bit residency; previousCS release residency plus1us is latched.17-bit reported-age sum saturates, first reply cannot qualify, and exact configured250..440us limits gate valid. Samples continue aging through bad CRCs; trusted invalid health clears immediately; third failure latches. No saturation rollover creates fresh data.

Disabling an already synced port latches the master fault, so re-enable alone cannot reuse a running session. INIT readiness does not create valid observations. Factory/ACTIVE/analog providers remain unavailable rather than inferred from diagnostic link success.
